params.name: objectField
params.description: Indexed object field; must be an indexed Object-type field or an error is returned

params.name: pathArray
params.description: Receives the distinct attribute paths (dot notation), in alphabetical (diacritic) order

overloads.semanticRole: Returns, in alphabetical order, the list of distinct object attribute paths found in an indexed Object field for the current selection.

constraints: objectField must be an indexed Object-type field; otherwise an error is returned.
Records with an undefined value in objectField are not taken into account.
Does not change the current selection or the current record.
